body.p: No claims are amended or cancelled.

Claims 1-3 were rejected on the ground of non-statutory obviousness-type double patenting over claims of US Patent 11,810,422. Without acquiescing to the propriety of the rejection, and to facilitate prosecution, Applicant submits a terminal disclaimer herewith. The filing of a terminal disclaimer is not an admission and does not give rise to any presumption or estoppel on the merits of the rejection. Quad Envtl. Techs. Corp. vs. Union Sanitary District, 946 F.2d 870 (Fed. Cir. 1991). Accordingly, withdrawal of this rejection is respectfully requested.

The pending claims are in condition for allowance for at least the reasons set forth above. Applicant does not acquiesce to the Office's characterizations of the claim language or the cited reference(s), and reserves the right to challenge any such characterizations in the future. Any changes to the claims in this response, which have not been specifically noted to overcome a rejection based upon the cited portions of the above-cited reference(s), should be considered to have been made for a purpose unrelated to patentability, and no estoppel should be deemed to attach thereto. The Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney at the telephone number listed below if such a call would in any way facilitate allowance of this application.
